title: Thinking on how Different Learners Solve Problems, Buy Goods and Go on their Customer Journeys
summary: Kahran and Divya compare how each of them takes in information — Kahran retains every photo he's taken, Divya retains what she reads — and trace that out into how they shop. They get into Pinterest as a wishlist of moods you'll never execute, why talking through a creative idea sometimes raises critical mass and sometimes evaporates it, and how the same different-learner pattern shows up in customer journeys.
topics: talking through ideas before doing them

intents.display: to think about how different learners shop and make creative decisions
